messages:
ana (partnerships): Quick heads-up: Azure marketplace listing kickoff. Goal: soft launch within ~2 weeks. Need owners for manifest, pricing mapping, legal sign-off, and promo assets.
liam (cloud-partner): I can own the Azure side and loop their PM (mentioned as @mike-azure). They asked for an OfferID (staging ok), a one-page pricing table, and expected monthly usage bands to validate metering.
priya (product): Packaging call: recommend SaaS (managed) listing — smoother install and uses SaaS fulfillment. BYOS needs VM images and adds QA burden. Thoughts?
tom (ops): SaaS works for infra. We need an ARM template or lightweight deploy bundle for their validation, plus a /health endpoint and a simple metering webhook. I can stub a minimal ARM and meter payload.
marketplace-bot: manifest.json -> error: plan["business"] missing billingPlanId. See: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/marketplace/plan-schema
liam (cloud-partner): Azure requires usageDimension + planId per pricing tier. We'll map tokens->usageDimension but need a clear conversion table.
priya (product): I'll propose three tiers: dev (<=100k tokens/month), standard (<=1M), enterprise (committed qps + custom pricing). I'll draft a 1-page pricing table and include tokens->billing units conversion.
vera (legal): I'll start the Publisher Agreement review. Please upload the draft MSA and a data flow diagram. I need explicit data residency language, DSAR contact, and retention/deletion rules for logs.
nana (partnerships) — correction: ana: @vera I'll drop the MSA in 15m. @priya lean SaaS unless legal flags otherwise.
priya (product): Agreed SaaS. I'll add a note: "Enterprise option supports customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)" in the feature bullets.
tom (ops): For metering conversion, propose rounding: 1 billing unit = 1000 tokens, round-up per request. We'll add monthly caps and a grace buffer for overages. I'll add placeholders in the example manifest.
marketplace-bot: manifest lint: warning: promotionalImages/1024x.png missing. Also missing supportEmail in publisher metadata.
liam (cloud-partner): Azure also asks for promo images (1024x, 80x80) and a short marketing blurb (<= 500 characters). They prefer a zipped offer package for upload.
priya (product): I'll prepare 3 screenshots and a 350-char description + 3 bullets. Will attach a mock price table and the tokens->unit mapping in the PR.
vera (legal): Quick compliance Q: any user-facing crypto libraries or special export-controlled tech? If so we need ECC declarations.
priya (product): No special crypto, just TLS and standard auth. I'll note that in the compliance doc.
tom (ops): I'll create a non-prod publish bundle with placeholders by EOD and post a dummy staging OfferID. ETA 6pm PT.
liam (cloud-partner): I'll ping Azure PM to request a staging OfferID once the bundle is ready so they can validate metering.
nana (partnerships): Timeline recap: today fix manifest + create staging bundle; tomorrow legal review; day after validate in Azure portal. Owners: ana (overall), liam (azure contact), priya (product/pricing), tom (ops/deploy), vera (legal).
priya (product): PR checklist: manifest.json, pricing table, tokens->unit mapping, ARM template stub, MSA draft, screenshots. Tagging @vera @tom @liam for review.
marketplace-bot: manifest check: plan["dev"] pricingTier should be lowercase -> will fail strict validation.
vera (legal): Uploading MSA draft to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link. Please comment inline by tomorrow 11:00am PT.
liam (cloud-partner): Also note: Azure meter expects usageDimensionId per plan. I'll share the sample manifest snippet from their docs to avoid rework.
tom (ops): I'll include an example metering event payload in the bundle: {"customerId":"...","usageUnits": 1 } and a tiny healthcheck returned by /health.
priya (product): Product question: list multi-region support or single region? Suggest listing "global" but call out EU data residency for EU customers.
vera (legal): I'll prepare a GDPR addendum short clause and include residency notes; will add DSAR contact and deletion SLA.
nana (partnerships): Scheduling quick 20m sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to confirm staging OfferID. If blockers, post here before the sync. Thanks!
liam (cloud-partner): +1.
priya (product): +1.
tom (ops): +1.
vera (legal): +1, I'll have redlines before the sync.
